python - <<'PY'
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
report=json.loads(Path('/logs/verifier/initializer-wheel-resolution.json').read_text())
lines=[]
for item in report['install']:
    name=item['metadata']['name'];version=item['metadata']['version']
    download=item['download_info'];digest=download['archive_info']['hashes']['sha256']
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+',name)
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.+!-]+',version)
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',digest)
    url=urlsplit(download['url'])
    assert url.scheme=='https' and url.hostname=='files.pythonhosted.org'
    if not url.path.endswith('.whl'): continue
    lines.append(f'{name}=={version} --hash=sha256:{digest}')
assert lines
Path('/logs/verifier/initializer-wheel-requirements.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
uv pip install --system --python /usr/local/bin/python3 --require-hashes --no-deps --link-mode hardlink -r /logs/verifier/initializer-wheel-requirements.txt
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.metadata,json
from pathlib import Path
report=json.loads(Path('/logs/verifier/initializer-wheel-resolution.json').read_text())
packages=[];large=[]
for item in report['install']:
    if not item['download_info']['url'].split('?',1)[0].endswith('.whl'): continue
    name=item['metadata']['name'];version=item['metadata']['version']
    dist=importlib.metadata.distribution(name)
    assert dist.version==version,(name,dist.version,version)
    packages.append({'name':name,'version':version})
    for relative in dist.files or []:
        path=dist.locate_file(relative)
        if not path.is_file(): continue
        stat=path.stat()
        if stat.st_size>=64*1024**2:
            large.append({'package':name,'path':str(relative),'bytes':stat.st_size,'links':stat.st_nlink})
assert large and all(row['links']>=2 for row in large), 'large wheel files must share cache inodes'
Path('/logs/verifier/initializer-wheel-layout.json').write_text(json.dumps({'packages':packages,'large_files':large},indent=2)+'\n')
PY
